claim: Aura's canonical browser-duplex and resident sounddevice voice surfaces cannot contend for the host microphone, cannot ingest audio without a live lease, and cannot retain room I/O after the runtime setting is revoked.
implemented: A process-scoped MicrophoneAuthority assigns explicit leases by physical resource group, principal, source, mode, session, generation, heartbeat, and preemption policy.
Focused browser conversation preempts passive resident listening; equal-or-lower priority capture is refused with a named denial and paired-device microphones remain physically independent.
AudioIngressBroker rejects and meters PCM frames unless their source still owns the authoritative lease.
SovereignVoiceEngine obtains a passive lease before touching sounddevice, closes the native handle when preempted, and sends callbacks through the ingress broker.

The authenticated duplex route reserves a lease before model/session construction, continuously revalidates principal, runtime settings, and lease ownership, and releases the lease on every exit path.
Browser getUserMedia starts only after voice.ready proves authentication, lease admission, and ASR/TTS warmup; socket loss and terminal admission failures stop every MediaStream track.
Mute physically stops the browser microphone track and unmute reacquires it only while the authenticated authoritative socket remains live.
voice.input_enabled revokes all active leases before resident owner cleanup, while invalid runtime settings fail closed for microphone and room-audio output.

static_integrity.result: Ruff touched-file checks, Python byte compilation, Node syntax, and git diff hygiene passed

diagnosis: Six equal-tool receipts are invalid because the producer truthfully records failed/refused sandbox attempts while the validator incorrectly requires every charged operation to succeed.
The complete system's three successes came from executable amplification; recurrent latent optimization accepted zero steps and applied no fast weights in all seven cells.
Planning, calibration, coding, and two program branches exhausted a shared 320-token budget; no operation-specific continuation or syntax repair existed.
Hash-diverse but causally correlated programs promoted the same wrong upper-median interpretation without exact objective proof.

remaining: Migrate every secondary native microphone owner and retire or lease-fence legacy chunk/WS ingress; add a static ratchet against new direct capture APIs.
Make capture-active status distinct from lease ownership and scope TTS/audio streams per authenticated session.
Run multilingual, noisy-room, device-loss, reconnect, barge-in, and rebuilt-app microphone-to-mind-to-speaker proof on physical hardware.
Repair the campaign receipt schema and reasoning engine before a new source-bound WOW campaign.
